live: each call is a button that sends its `tools/call` request to the page's database in your browser and shows the request and the reply, built from the engine's result the way `relate serve --mcp` builds it, with the statement and parameters editable; "Serve read-only" drops `write_cypher` from the tool list, as `--read-only` does, and shows the engine's own refusal of the write on a read-only database beside the server's recorded answer.
text:
These calls ran when the page was recorded, on a database that holds what this page's cells write, through the same mapping the live tryout uses. Timings show as `<ms>`; live, each reply carries the timings of its own run. The server lists `write_cypher`, `read_cypher`, `get_schema`.

**`read_cypher`**: the request a host sends, then the reply.

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read_cypher","arguments":{"statement":"UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"}}}
```

```json

```

**`read_cypher`** with a write: the plan's operators read as query type `w`, so the server refuses the call before it runs. The request a host sends, then the reply:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read_cypher","arguments":{"statement":"CREATE (:Person {name: $name})","parameters":{"name":"Ada"}}}}
```

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"content":[{"text":"Only MATCH queries are allowed for read-query","type":"text"}],"isError":true}}
```

Tool error: `Only MATCH queries are allowed for read-query`.

**`write_cypher`**: the request a host sends, then the reply.

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"write_cypher","arguments":{"statement":"CREATE (:Person {name: $name})","parameters":{"name":"Ada"}}}}
```


Counters: `nodes_created` 1, `properties_set` 1, `labels_added` 1; `rows` is empty, as `write_cypher` returns counters.

**`get_schema`**: the request a host sends, then the reply.

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_schema","arguments":{}}}
```

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"result":{"content":[{"text":"{\"Person\":{\"count\":1,\"properties\":{\"name\":{\"type\":\"String\"}},\"type\":\"node\"}}","type":"text"}],"isError":false}}
```

**`write_cypher` on a server started `--read-only`**: it lists only `read_cypher` and `get_schema`, and answers a `write_cypher` call with a tool error before the engine sees the statement. This run is recorded from relate 1.0.1 (errors.json `mcp-unknown-tool`, replayed against the binary by `docs:cli-check`); the page quotes it as the binary printed it:

```bash
printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"check","version":"0"}}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"write_cypher","arguments":{"query":"CREATE (:B)"}}}' | relate serve --mcp stdio --database ./graph.rl --read-only
```

```text
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"capabilities":{"tools":{}},"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","serverInfo":{"name":"relate-mcp","version":"1.0.1"}}}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"content":[{"text":"unknown tool 'write_cypher'","type":"text"}],"isError":true}}
```

Transport answers (HTTP 401, 403 and 415, the body cap, the header deadline) are not part of the tryout; the [MCP server reference](/docs/reference/server/mcp#errors-and-refusals) lists them.
